label: e2e bench on the v8 and v9 app templates, #22112 on ccdd8ce844, second run
why: #22112 runs the e2e bench on new copies of the v8 and v9 app templates and scores each skill, so the datasets and the evaluators change. Full check with e2e on ccdd8ce844, with a clean tree, against the local Designer stack, with the preview check off as in production. The quick evals match the last baseline: gate_verdict 1.000 on Gates/scope and Gates/security, 1.000 on Planner/intake and Planner/spec, and on Loop/traces 1.000 for gen_stopped_cleanly, 0.000 for gen_content_pairings and 0.889 for gen_required_tools, where one replay calls edit_file without verify_changes, as in the baseline before the last one. The v9 build committed an app. Each of its failed checks was read against the app, and each is a mistake by the assistant: no custom receipt, no BPMN diagram, a signing task without minCount, runDefaultValidator or SigningDocumentList, prefill targets that start with Model., and no error rule for D6 against D7. The v8 build committed no app: the session hung after the intake and timed out after 30 minutes. In the two runs before this one, the v8 build committed an incomplete app once and repeated one edit until the loop stopped it once. So the v8 build and skill behaviors have no score, and the run is adopted with --force, which also covers the two render behaviors that the render check leaves unscored. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
